name: Fully Charged, No Charger

leader.name: Mad Scientist
leader.passive: After mulligans, put the top 5 cards of your deck face down and Ready into your Stash. You do not receive setup temporary Stash and cannot use the normal once-per-Round Stash action. Your Stash cannot contain more than 5 cards and does not Ready during your Ready step. At the start of your Turn, before Ready, Ready 1 Stash.
leader.note: The five-card battery is a hard cap. All five begin Ready; spent charge recovers only one Stash per Turn unless a card explicitly Readies additional Stash.

specimen_rack.mechanical_identity: Each approved external card represents the same 2/2 Specimen Part Character token when released.

mulligan_priority: It's Alive! plus at least two Characters
Lab Assistant if It's Alive! is missing
Avoid hands with too many recharge cards before spending the initial battery
test_watchpoints: How much of the five-charge battery is spent on Turn 1
Whether holding charge for a later Turn is better than emptying the battery
Power/Guard roll distributions and how much each stat affects outcomes
Whether low-roll Abominations create funny setbacks without making games feel decided by one die
Whether high-roll Abominations feel like jackpots without creating non-games
Turns where the Scientist has cards to play but insufficient Ready Stash
How often Flip the Breaker and Car Battery in the Bathtub extend the battery meaningfully
Whether the opponent can survive an explosive opening and capitalize on Burnout
Whether Specimens are fun physical theater without becoming rules overhead
